notes.title: The Silicon Wasteland Demo is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=v4f9tlsaiQg;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3221200/Silicon_Wasteland_Demo/]Play the demo here![/url]

After experiencing a cryptic dream, a lone android awakens to the wind and rain of the quiet apocalypse. In this short preview, follow Silica, as she assesses her mysterious circumstances in an abandoned warehouse.

This demo contains the Prologue chapter, as well as the first major scene of the main story content of [b]SILICON WASTELAND[/b], a kinetic visual novel set during the twilight years of humanity. Featuring music from the amazing Janice Kwan (TUNIC), as well as additional music by Vidboy.

Approximate demo completion time: 25 minutes.

The full game of Silicon Wasteland is slated to release in 2025. Thank you for your patience!

Follow on X (Twitter) for more updates.
